product_overview: AgriSathi is a local-first farming assistant web app that helps users sign up, log in, and access crop, weather, irrigation, market, and settings tools from a unified dashboard. It also includes an in-app chatbot for farming guidance.
core_goals: Create an account and access the app
Log in and reach the dashboard
Review crop, weather, irrigation, and market insights
Manage farm profile and app preferences
Get farming advice through the chatbot

features.name: User Signup
features.description: Register a new account by entering personal and farm details, then access the application.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill in name, email, mobile number, password, crop preferences, and farm details -> Submit the signup form -> See the account created and access the next screen

features.name: User Login
features.description: Sign in with existing email or mobile credentials to enter the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email or mobile number -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an error message

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: View an overview of farm status, crop health, and quick recommendations, and move to other app areas.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See dashboard cards and key metrics -> Review crop overview and recommendations -> Move to other feature pages from the dashboard

features.name: Weather and Crops
features.description: Check current weather, browse forecasts, and view crop suitability recommendations based on weather conditions.
user_flows: Navigate to /weather -> View current weather data -> Browse the weather forecast -> Review crop recommendations based on the weather

features.name: Smart Irrigation
features.description: View irrigation scheduling guidance, water usage recommendations, and adjust irrigation settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /irrigation -> View the irrigation schedule -> Review water usage recommendations -> Update irrigation settings -> See the updated irrigation guidance

features.name: Market Intelligence
features.description: Review commodity price predictions, demand analysis, and import/export trade information.
user_flows: Navigate to /market -> View commodity price predictions -> Browse demand analysis charts -> Review import/export trade data

features.name: Settings
features.description: Manage profile information, farm details, crop preferences, and application preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> View profile information -> Edit farm details and crop preferences -> Save the updated settings -> See the changes reflected in the account
Navigate to /settings -> Choose to log out -> See the session end and return to the login screen

features.name: AI Chatbot
features.description: Open the in-app assistant, send farming questions, and receive AI-generated advice.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the chatbot -> Type a farming question -> Send the message -> See an AI-generated response

known_limitations.issue: Authentication uses localStorage only, no backend API calls
known_limitations.impact: User data is not persisted across devices or browsers
